record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Find classes of ideals for which one can obtain useful upper bounds on the regularity of products of ideals in those classes.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S = k[x_1, \ldots, x_n]$ be a polynomial ring over a field $k$, graded in the standard way. For a homogeneous ideal $I \subseteq S$, let $\mathrm{reg}(I)$ denote the Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity of $I$, defined as 
$$\mathrm{reg}(I) = \max\{ j - i : \beta_{i,j}(I) \neq 0 \},$$
where $\beta_{i,j}(I)$ are the graded Betti numbers of $I$.

In general, the regularity is not well-behaved under products: there exist homogeneous ideals $I, J$ for which $\mathrm{reg}(IJ) > \mathrm{reg}(I) + \mathrm{reg}(J)$, and no useful general upper bound is known relating $\mathrm{reg}(I_1 I_2 \cdots I_d)$ to invariants of the individual factors $I_1, \ldots, I_d$.

Identify natural classes $\mathcal{C}$ of homogeneous ideals in $S$ (for instance, classes defined by combinatorial, geometric, or homological conditions) for which one can prove useful upper bounds on $\mathrm{reg}(I_1 I_2 \cdots I_d)$ when $I_1, \ldots, I_d \in \mathcal{C}$, expressed in terms of natural invariants of $I_1, \ldots, I_d$ (such as their individual regularities, generating degrees, or combinatorial parameters describing them).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is an open-ended research direction. Partial progress exists for specific classes: for edge ideals, upper bounds for products of two edge ideals in terms of co-chordal cover number have been established, and lower bounds for products of multiple edge ideals are known. However, a comprehensive identification of classes admitting useful upper bounds on regularity of products remains an active and largely open research direction.

status_evidence.title: Bounds for the regularity of product of edge ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bound reg(IJ) ≤ max{co-chord(G)+3, reg(I)} for products of edge ideals; lower bounds for products of more than two edge ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for edge ideals, but general classes remain open.

status_evidence.title: Upper bounds for the regularity of powers of edge ideals of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies upper bounds for regularity of powers of edge ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Active research area with partial bounds for specific classes.

status_evidence.title: Linearly presented modules and bounds on the Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity of ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Bounds on Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity of ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing research on regularity bounds in various classes of ideals.
